description: Broker long-tail question set for California auto insurance. Use for validation, corpus expansion, and broker value sessions.

questions.question_zh: 15/30/5 具体是什么意思？客户问我要解释清楚。
questions.question_en: What does 15/30/5 mean? Client wants a clear explanation.
questions.notes: Extends Q1; corpus has DMV/insurance.ca.gov coverage types

questions.question_zh: 客户想买高于最低的保额，有什么推荐？比如 50/100 还是 100/300？
questions.question_en: Client wants more than minimum coverage. What's recommended? 50/100 vs 100/300?
questions.notes: General guidance exists; specific limits vary by carrier

questions.question_zh: 什么是 SR-22？谁需要？怎么办理？
questions.question_en: What is SR-22? Who needs it? How to get it?
questions.notes: DMV has SR-22 page; broker_demo_urls includes it; high-value for high-risk clients

questions.question_zh: 客户需要提供什么保险证明？电子卡可以吗？
questions.question_en: What proof of insurance does client need? Is electronic card OK?
questions.notes: DMV proof-of-insurance page in broker_demo_urls

questions.question_zh: 客户的车注册被暂停了，但他说已经买了保险，为什么还会被停？
questions.question_en: Client's registration was suspended but they say they have insurance. Why?
questions.notes: Extends Q2; DMV mentions VIN mismatch, insurer not reporting

questions.question_zh: 客户 DUI 后需要什么保险才能恢复驾照？
questions.question_en: What insurance does client need after DUI to restore license?
questions.notes: SR-22 + high-risk; corpus may have DMV SR-22; carrier-specific for who writes

questions.question_zh: 好司机折扣具体能省多少？各公司一样吗？
questions.question_en: How much does good driver discount save? Same across carriers?
questions.notes: Q4 covers categories; percentages vary by carrier; insurance.ca.gov discount pages 404

questions.question_zh: 客户有防御性驾驶课证书，能打折吗？
questions.question_en: Client has defensive driving certificate. Can they get a discount?
questions.notes: Q4 broker hint mentions 防御性驾驶; carrier-specific acceptance

questions.question_zh: 出险后多久内必须报案？24 小时？
questions.question_en: How soon must client report a claim after accident? 24 hours?
questions.notes: Q5 covers flow; timing guidance missing; varies by carrier

questions.question_zh: 客户出险了，对方全责，应该找谁理赔？
questions.question_en: Client had accident, other party at fault. Who to claim from?
questions.notes: Own insurer vs other party's; general guidance in corpus

questions.question_zh: 客户问：怎么投诉保险公司？加州有官方渠道吗？
questions.question_en: How to file complaint against insurer? Is there official CA channel?
questions.notes: CDI has complaints; may need corpus expansion

questions.question_zh: 客户要准备哪些材料才能顺利报价？
questions.question_en: What documents should client prepare for a quote?
questions.notes: Q4 broker hint has 客户可准备; carrier-specific lists

questions.question_zh: 客户说：我开车很少，为什么保费还这么高？
questions.question_en: Client says they drive very little. Why is premium still high?
questions.notes: Low-mileage discount exists; other factors (location, record) matter

questions.question_zh: 客户从外州搬来加州，原来的保险能用吗？
questions.question_en: Client moved from another state. Can they keep old insurance?
questions.notes: CA minimums differ; must meet CA requirements

questions.question_zh: 客户没有车但需要保险（比如租车、借车），有什么选择？
questions.question_en: Client has no car but needs insurance (e.g. rental, borrowing). Options?
questions.notes: Non-owner policy; rental coverage; corpus likely thin

questions.question_zh: 碰撞险和综合险有什么区别？新车必须买吗？
questions.question_en: What's the difference between collision and comprehensive? Required for new car?
questions.notes: Q1 fallback mentions both; GEICO/Progressive have coverage pages

questions.question_zh: 客户问：为什么不同公司报价差这么多？正常吗？
questions.question_en: Why do quotes vary so much between companies? Is that normal?
questions.notes: Rate factors; underwriting; broker can explain

questions.question_zh: 客户有事故记录，还能拿到好司机折扣吗？
questions.question_en: Client has accident on record. Can they still get good driver discount?
questions.notes: CA good driver definition; 18-month lookback; corpus may have

questions.question_zh: 贷款买的车，银行要求什么保险？
questions.question_en: Client financed car. What does the bank require for insurance?
questions.notes: Lender typically requires collision + comprehensive; gap insurance

questions.question_zh: 客户问：保险卡上的 NAIC 号是什么？有什么用？
questions.question_en: What is NAIC number on insurance card? What's it for?
questions.notes: DMV suspended page mentions NAIC; edge case for reinstatement

categories.proof_of_insurance_sr22: Proof of insurance, SR-22, electronic cards
categories.documentation_client_prep: What client needs to prepare, documents
